free_parameters.name: pattern
free_parameters.why: Repository default pattern. The class-name dispatch at the target happens before any pattern-specific code, and with 'default' patch_llama_attention / patch_qwen2_attention return immediately, so no GPU kernel is needed.

free_parameters.name: cfg
free_parameters.why: Empty config dict. It is not read by the class-name dispatch, and patch_model_config applies no extra attributes for the default pattern.

free_parameters.name: model_kwargs
free_parameters.why: Tiny random-initialised HF config so CPU construction is fast. The target decision depends only on type(model).__name__, not on model size or weights; the same kwargs are used for both classes.

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: Fixed seed for deterministic weight initialisation across repeats and the clean-checkout replay; the target decision does not depend on the weights.

execution.entry_reason: The Region call chain lists flex_prefill_attention as its first function, but that function is a GPU attention kernel and never calls patch_hf_model. The target is reached through the repository's real public caller patch_model, which checks PreTrainedModel and dispatches to patch_hf_model, so the branch is evaluated on a real HF model class.
